name: York University
feeMethod: Charges per credit at slightly different rates by faculty, so the calculator uses the degree's programme rate.
description: York University is a public research university in Toronto, Ontario, founded in 1959 and one of Canada's largest. It includes the Schulich School of Business, the Lassonde School of Engineering and Osgoode Hall Law School.
whyIncluded: York University is an NUS Student Exchange Programme partner, so NUS undergraduates can spend a semester studying at York.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate for a student in residence with a meal plan over an 8-month year (midpoints of its ranges); local transport not included.
livingCosts.notes: York Future Students tuition page, 'Estimated Living Expenses' 2026-27, residence column: residence C$9,000-13,000 (midpoint 11,000) and meal plan C$4,350-8,000 (midpoint 6,175) for 8 months; personal expenses C$4,200 (about C$350/month). Off-campus: apartment C$12,000+, food C$4,800, personal C$5,400. Health/dental C$359 excluded. No transport figure is given.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (BEng), Lassonde School of Engineering
programmes.feeBasis: York's 2025-26 international per-credit rate for Lassonde Engineering (C$1,235.99/credit) times 36 credits a year, plus per-credit supplementary fees.
programmes.feeChoice: Charged per credit by faculty, so the Lassonde Engineering rate for a 36-credit year is used as the yearly rate.
programmes.summary: Annual tuition and supplementary fees for international students who started in 2025-26 (the latest year with a published programme fee table). Fees usually rise each year; health insurance extra.
programmes.notes: York Student Financial Services 'Course and Program Fees / FW25 / Lassonde School of Engineering - Bachelor of Engineering', for students entering on or after 3 Sept 2025: international tuition C$1,235.99/credit + supplementary fees C$43.56/credit (centrally collected ancillary and student levies, e.g. athletics and recreation, health and counselling, York Federation of Students) x 36 credits. The 2026-27 per-programme tables on the same site are not yet readable; York's Future Students tuition page gives only rounded 2026-27 estimates (most programmes about C$40,000, Computer Science C$38,000, Engineering C$47,000 for 36 credits, tuition only), so 2025-26 is the current row. UHIP and the opt-out YFS health plan excluded. 2024 row: 'Course and Program Fees / FW24 / Lassonde School of Engineering-BEng' (entering on or after 4 Sept 2024): C$1,166.03/credit tuition + C$40.18/credit supplementary x 36. 36 credits: York's tuition page bases Engineering estimates on 36 credits a year. Rechecked 2026-10-13: the sfs.yorku.ca 2026-2027 fall-winter page for this programme exists but its fee table is still empty, so 2025-26 stays current. Fix 2026-10-15: checked for 2026-27 fees; the FW26 page https://sfs.yorku.ca/fees/courses/2026-2027/fall-winter/lassonde/engineering exists (HTTP 200) but its tuition table still has no figures (only the empty Domestic and International rows), so the record stays at feeYear 2025 until York publishes the 2026-27 table.

Round 5 (2026-10-13): fetched directly with curl, sfs.yorku.ca/fees/courses/2024-2025/fall-winter/lassonde/computer-science returns an empty FW24 table in the server HTML (the BEng page has its rates in the same HTML), and guessed alternative Lassonde slugs return the same empty template, so 2024 remains unfilled. Round 6 (2026-10-13): about 40 further slug guesses under sfs.yorku.ca/fees/courses/2024-2025/fall-winter/lassonde/ (e.g. software-engineering, eecs, other-programs, bsc) all return the empty FW24 template; only lassonde/engineering (BEng, international C$1,166.03/credit) and the Faculty of Science page (C$1,220.71/credit) have FW24 tables, and neither is this programme. The students.yorku.ca fee index returns 502. A futurestudents.yorku.ca 'Test Page for UG fees' (node/313) shows Computer Science international C$28,437 under a mislabelled 2026-27 heading, so it was not used. No 2024 row. Round 7 (2026-10-13, Common Crawl captures of official pages): The FW24 Lassonde CS table is empty, so the 2024-25 per-credit tuition is taken from York's Summer 2024 table for the same programme: York charges one tuition rate per academic year from the summer term (checked: SU24 = FW24 tuition for Science C$1,220.71 and Lassonde Engineering C$1,166.03; SU25 CS C$1,189.47 = FW25 CS; SU23 CS C$1,043.85 = FW23 CS). 30 credits x C$1,122.14 = C$33,664.20. Compulsory: FW24 supplementary C$39.02/credit (FW24 Faculty of Science page; SU24 CS and SU24 Science both C$37.60, so the central FW24 rate is the same) x 30 = C$1,170.60, the figure already used for the BSc 2024 row; tuition + supplementary = C$34,834.80, matching York Future Students' C$34,835 2024-25 total for Computer Science. Fix 2026-10-15: checked for 2026-27 fees; the FW26 page https://sfs.yorku.ca/fees/courses/2026-2027/fall-winter/lassonde/computer-science exists (HTTP 200) but its tuition table still has no figures (only the empty Domestic and International rows), so the record stays at feeYear 2025 until York publishes the 2026-27 table.
